suppress.notes: braces 3.0.3 (latest release): only in Metro/Jest file watching inside Expo build tooling, expanding glob patterns from our own config. Not in the server or the app bundle. See dependency-exploitability.md.

image-size 1.2.1: only Metro reading the size of images checked into mobile/assets while bundling. The fixed 2.x breaks Metro 0.83 (it passes file paths), and there is no patched 1.x. Not in the server (uploads use sharp) or the app bundle. See dependency-exploitability.md.

node-forge 1.4.0 (latest release): only in Expo's CLI/expo-updates code-signing certificate tooling. Chord configures no update code signing, installed apps verify updates in native code, and the server never verifies signatures with node-forge. See dependency-exploitability.md.
